params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $bootstrap=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeRepo\heaven-bridge\bootstrap.ps1'; if(-not (Test-Path $bootstrap)){throw "bootstrap missing: $bootstrap"}; Start-Process powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-Command',("Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; & '"+$bootstrap+"'"); Write-Output 'HEAVEN_BRIDGE_RESTART_SCHEDULED'
